title: The host's orientation peek for a read-only child should carry no context generation, so Engram shows it no directive it cannot follow
outcome: For a read-only delegation child the host's orientation read (`work next --peek`) carries no `--context-generation`, so Engram shows that child no directive telling it to run `memories --context-generation <token>`, a call its read-only gate denies. The child still reads its memories at start as its project's instructions require. Writable sessions keep the generation.
acceptance: Engram's coordinator confirms, by mailbox cited by message number, that a peek without a generation shows no memories directive after Engram w-4e799f05b07a.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and diff hash cited in a note.
The orientation read the host runs for a read-only delegation child has no --context-generation argument; a test reads the arguments for a read-only child and for a writable session.
